cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

mechanism: A confidently sells a disastrous plan as prudent, then adopts B objections as adjustable safeguards to keep B supporting the supposed inevitability.
confusable: Distinguish mere optimism from a plan with demonstrable practical disaster, rationalized as responsible and unavoidable while A concedes process.
comparison: Roof removal destroys wet-weather trading; debt-funded charity auction without bidders deepens borrowing to protect sunk donation.
seedUse: Canonical roof and auction seeds provide bad plans; S02 should yield control of safeguards or spending to preserve cooperation without making plan genuinely sound.
